quote: The 8 Rubber-Tired Gantry (RTG) cranes will be delivered to a new container terminal at Puerto Antioquia, Colombia … The order was booked in August 2023. The eight RTGs for Puerto Antioquia were ordered by Puerto Bahia Colombia de Uraba, whose key shareholder is the CMA CGM Group … They are fully electric, powered by cable reels connected to the local grid.
note: Opened Konecranes 19 Sep 2023 (Puerto Antioquia 8 RTG order).
